Oolutanga's Refuge's Mage 22721 and Healer 22725 are the island's shop: TODO(m6-island-vendors), item 4's, never added as vendors here (D48) Shopkeeper Renald the Elder 718 also sells the Leather Gauntlets 56 (Value 1,100, 1,485 pyreals; armour level 130, burden 270, ValidLocations 0x20, ClothingPriority 0x8000, no wield requirement; his create list holds it in the pinned SQL): the gear floor's hand armour (M6 7 AH: a corpse run's replace step buys it when no worn piece covers the hands). M6 8 D (m5-side-packs-use, m5-pack-short): the Pack row of Shopkeeper Renald the Elder: SELECT weenie_Class_Id FROM weenie_properties_create_list WHERE object_Id = 718 AND destination_Type = 4 AND weenie_Class_Id = 136 (one row, the world SQL v0.9.296); weenie 136 is a Container (ItemType 0x200, ItemsCapacity 24, PropertyInt 19 'Value' 65); price = max(1, ceil(1.35 x 65 - 0.1)) = 88. M6 14 (m6-purse; live 2026-11-12: a level 39 mage's main pack stood full of rings, bracelets, necklaces and gems, the sale named each one outside every listed mask and the loot rule then left every corpse for want of a free slot): Monyra the Jeweler 716 is the outskirts profile's fifth Holtburg row verbatim (holtburg-outskirts.json: guid 0x7A9B4020, cell and stop_cell 0xA9B40117, Archmage Cindrue's entry hall, point (157.19, 135.298, 66.12), buys_item_types 0x00040808 = Jewelry 0x8 + Gem 0x800 + PromissoryNote 0x40000, buy_price 0.9, no 'sells': a loot buyer only): SELECT li.guid, HEX(li.obj_Cell_Id), li.origin_X, li.origin_Y, li.origin_Z, i.value, f.value FROM landblock_instance li JOIN weenie_properties_int i ON i.object_Id = li.weenie_Class_Id AND i.type = 74 JOIN weenie_properties_float f ON f.object_Id = li.weenie_Class_Id AND f.type = 37 WHERE li.weenie_Class_Id = 716 (one row: 2056994848, A9B40117, 157.19, 135.298, 66.12, 264200, 0.9; a SELECT on the world copy, 2026-11-12). Her MerchandiseMinValue (int 75) is 0 and her MerchandiseMaxValue (int 76) 1,000,000, and ACE's sale reads neither (Player_Commerce.cs VerifySellItems 232-298 @95ef426d: the mask, IsSellable, Retained, a Value of 1 or more, an empty container). Novedion the Gem Seller 9423 (outdoors at (124.79, 31.52, 94.01), mask 0x808, MerchandiseMaxValue 25,000) is not listed: Monyra's walk is the one the dat tests confirm (VendorStopConfirmDatTests and ResupplyRouteDatTests walk every vendor of the den's profile, hers among them) and the outskirts, the Burrow and the Lodge list her already. M6 14 grocer (the owner, 2026-11-13: sell the empty flasks; live 2026-11-13 04:54 UTC: the supply trip named every Empty Flask outside Monyra the Jeweler's mask and kept it): Fispur Ansel the Grocer 714 (holtburggrocer) is the outskirts profile's row verbatim (holtburg-outskirts.json: guid 0x7A9B4024, cell and stop_cell 0xA9B4016A, his shop, point (78.9714, 38.5313, 94.005), buys_item_types 0x00446220 = Food 0x20 + Container 0x200 + Writable 0x2000 + Key 0x4000 + PromissoryNote 0x40000 + CraftCookingBase 0x400000, buy_price 0.9, no 'sells': a loot buyer only): SELECT li.guid, HEX(li.obj_Cell_Id), li.origin_X, li.origin_Y, li.origin_Z, i.value, f.value FROM landblock_instance li JOIN weenie_properties_int i ON i.object_Id = li.weenie_Class_Id AND i.type = 74 JOIN weenie_properties_float f ON f.object_Id = li.weenie_Class_Id AND f.type = 37 WHERE li.weenie_Class_Id = 714 (one row: 2056994852, A9B4016A, 78.9714, 38.5313, 94.005, 4481568, 0.9; a SELECT on the world copy, 2026-11-13). The Empty Flask (wcid 7940 flasksimple, ItemType 0x400000 CraftCookingBase, Value 1, MaxStackSize 1, so each one takes a slot; one is left by each potion she drinks, about 13 an hour) is in no other listed vendor's mask; ACE pays max(1, floor(0.9 x 1 + 0.1)) = 1 pyreal a flask (Vendor.cs GetBuyCost 591-599 @95ef426d). His MerchandiseMinValue (int 75) is 0 and his MerchandiseMaxValue (int 76) 1,000,000, and ACE's sale reads neither (Player_Commerce.cs VerifySellItems 232-298 @95ef426d: the mask, IsSellable, Retained, a Value of 1 or more, an empty container). Every other type of his mask is also Shopkeeper Renald the Elder's (0x480467A7), so he is listed after Renald: a tie of the loot buyers' counts goes to the profile's earlier row (ResupplyPlanner.LootBuyers), and that stays Renald. Her drinks (the Mana Potion 379, the Potion of Healing 377, the Health and Mana Tinctures 27319 and 27322) are Misc 0x80, outside his mask, and the sale keeps every drink she uses whatever a mask takes (ResupplyRun.DrinkInUse, m6-sale-keeps-drinks); a pack (Container) and a trade note are never offered (ResupplyRun.SaleItems). His stop is his own cell as Thelnoth's, Ecutha's and Monyra's are (the station's request stops ShopLeg.UnseenVendorReachMetres short of his point): the dat tests walk every vendor of the den's profile from Holtburg's lifestone, his leg among them (ResupplyRouteDatTests: the room graph's path, about 32 m, enters his shop through the room 0xA9B4016E and ends in 0xA9B4016A; VendorStopConfirmDatTests: the walker's pre-check confirms it and his point stands on the floor through the statics, and The_stations_walk_from_the_lifestone_to_the_Grocer_enters_his_shop_and_passes_the_pre_check plans the station's own request, his point with that range); the shop's two doors (0x7A9B401E and 0x7A9B401F, world objects the dats do not hold) and his body are not in those tests, and the walk to him has not been run live (TODO(m6-grocer-stop-point)).

M6 3 F3 (3-R10, closes TODO(m6-dungeon-account-formula)): the account formula of 'test' (SpellFormulaRules.CustomizeForAccount, read from the dats; what Winnie casts if she loses her Foci of Strife, HasFoci, Player_Spells.cs 458-488 @95ef426d) is carried beside the foci formula, as the outskirts carry it (holtburg-outskirts.json sources.components), for each spell level of the plan, pinned by HuntingGroundDatTests.A_climbers_dungeon_carries_the_account_test_formula_beside_the_foci_formula: V (spell level 5): Gold Scarab, Orange Taper, Hawthorn, Indigo Taper, Powdered Onyx, Turpeth, Red Taper, Birch Talisman; VI (spell level 6): Pyreal Scarab, Yellow Taper, Hawthorn, Violet Taper, Powdered Onyx, Turpeth, Indigo Taper, Birch Talisman. Every coloured taper, herb, powder and talisman is a row of Archmage Cindrue's create list (weenie 2304, weenie_properties_create_list, destination 4, the pinned world SQL v0.9.296; Value 25 tapers, 10 Hawthorn, 5 the powder, Turpeth and Talisman; price = max(1, ceil(1.35 x Value - 0.1)): 34, 14, 7); the scarabs are the foci formula's lines above. Carried, no Holtburg vendor sells them (not in 2304's create list): Gold Scarab, Pyreal Scarab, TODO(m6-island-vendors).
sources.supplies: M6 3 p2, sized from the rung 'quarters' as the outskirts profile was (holtburg-outskirts.json sources.supplies): the modelled rate is twice the move-on floor, 160 kills an hour, at the move-on ceiling of 7.6 casts a kill (ladder/war-mage.json) = 1216 casts an hour, all of them Flame Bolt V or VI as the worst case, 4 Prismatic Tapers a cast on the foci formula = 4864 tapers an hour. Prismatic Taper 20631 (Archmage Cindrue, 30): keep 850 = 10 minutes of that burn (811) rounded up to 50 (capped at 1,000, a stack's limit; 6 burden each, and the capacity is the climber's Strength, TODO(m6-climber-strength)), trip_under 300 (a third of the keep rounded up to 50), stop_under 5 (a cast needs 4). Scarabs: the Gold Scarab 687 (V, levels 60-66) is CARRIED as in the Abode and the Temple 20-40 (keep 20, trip_under = stop_under = 2, TODO(m6-island-vendors)); the Pyreal Scarab 690 (VI, levels 67-74) is CARRIED as the den's (D8: Holtburg sells neither): keep 100, the stack's limit (MaxStackSize 100, burden 4 each), trip_under = stop_under = 3 (a stack under three stops the loop by name); its burn at VI is unmeasured (TODO(m6-component-loss-iii-v)), about twice Platinum's if the live cast facts hold, so 100 is the stack, not a day. The Copper Scarab 686 is on every spine profile at keep 20, trip_under 5, stop_under 2 (the Temple 40+'s line): the four travel spells (Lifestone Recall and Tie, Primary Portal Tie and Recall) burn one a cast on the foci formula, and GearKit.CastBurns refuses a ground that cannot buy it (GrantsCountedTests). Mana Potion 379 (Thelnoth, 230): keep 5, trip_under 2, stop_under 0, the outskirts' reserve. One restock from nothing at these keeps is 29,350 pyreals at the vendors' prices (850 Prismatic Tapers at 30 = 25,500; 20 Copper Scarabs at 135 = 2,700; 5 Mana Potions at 230 = 1,150); purse: coin 30,000 (that rounded up to 1,000, the floor the coin is kept at as the outskirts' is), notes of min_note 10,000 and up (the surplus is kept as bonded notes: a death takes half the coin and no note, Player_Death.cs:347-360 @95ef426d), the one note listed is the outskirts' placeholder count 1 (TODO(m6-purse-note-count)). kit: none, as the outskirts' and the Temple 20-40's (a kit line would put the ground into the level-80 buff-kit checks of GrantsCountedTests and MageBuildScenarioTests); the floor's Wand and Faran Robe with Hood stay sold by Cindrue and Ecutha for GearFloor; burden_trip_percent 150 as the outskirts'. M6 3 F3: the account formula's lines (herbs, powders, talismans, coloured tapers) are stock lines at keep 2, trip_under 2, stop_under 2, the outskirts' rule for them (holtburg-outskirts.json sources.supplies): a backup the focus-holding climber does not burn, a rung's cost of about 250 pyreals the first restock, inside the purse (see components) M6 item 14 (m6-goldscarab): the Gold Scarab 687 and the Pyreal Scarab 690 are no carried stock lines any more: both are the town stock's, bought at Uziz on the way out (the town_stock section gives the seller, the prices and the sizing); nothing of them stops the run, and no buy-trip is called for them here.

town_stock.name: Gold Scarab
town_stock.source: M6 item 14 (m6-goldscarab): the Gold Scarab 687 of level V at Archmage Sammam al-Ashiz 1824 of Uziz, 775 pyreals: the seller, the read-only SELECTs, the walk from the Network drop and back (TownNetworkWalkDatTests) and the sizing (0.02 a cast at the worst case, 25.1 an hour at about 1,250 casts; keep 100 is 4 hours, a stop at most every 2 h 23 min) are tusker-cave.json's town_stock line of the same ware. It replaces the carried stock line of this profile (trip_under = stop_under under which the run stopped by name): the ladder's character comes to this rung holding what the rung before left her, and a carried line under its stop line stops the run (LogisticsCounters, the stock stop) whether or not the plan casts its level yet (BuyTripRule: plan-below is not due, and for the Gold Scarab no-seller, TODO(m6-buy-trip-seller)). The spell plan's rows stay (the loader, GearKit.CastBurns and FightScenario.WarKitCarries take a town stock line for a plan component, HuntingGround.TownStockOf); a pack with neither scarab casts level III on the Copper Scarab line, the highest this profile's home walk sells (TODO(m6-silver-fallback): a Silver Scarab line would make that level IV; the lead's call).

town_stock.name: Pyreal Scarab
town_stock.source: M6 item 14 (m6-goldscarab): the Pyreal Scarab 690 of level VI at the same counter, 1,550 pyreals: sourced and sized in tusker-cave.json's town_stock line of the same ware (0.03 a cast at the worst case; keep 100 is 2 h 40 min, a stop at most every 96 minutes); not bought before the book holds a level VI spell. The carried Pyreal Scarab line of this profile and its buy-trip to Fort Tethana (session.md section 69) are replaced by this line for the same reason as the Gold Scarab's: the stop is on the way out and never stops the run.
